$comment: OFFICIAL runtime registry (ADR-004 §2). SSOT for the set of natively-supported runtimes and their adapter-socket metadata. Adapter-facing companion to ../mcp/mcp-plugin-delivery.contract.json: the per-runtime `mcp` block below is RECONCILED with that contract's `runtimes` block (same runtimes, same native path/format/server-map location) — that delivery contract remains SSOT for the MCP-server descriptor + gate tool; THIS file is the SSOT for which runtimes are officially supported and their adapter identity/persona/enumerate metadata. Third-party developers register their own adapters against the SAME adapter-socket contract (see ./adapter-socket.contract.md) WITHOUT being listed here — the registry is a convenience for first-party support, not a gate on who may implement (ADR-004 §2). ADR-004 GUT: the per-runtime *shape* of each seam (render / read / present / enumerate / materialize) now lives IN each template repo's adapter (the socket methods below), NOT in the shared engine. The engine (mcp_render / persona_render / loaded_mcp_tools_probe) keeps only GENERIC, runtime-name-free helpers (read_canonical_persona, write_persona, enumerate_from_specs_async, normalize_runtime) — it holds ZERO per-runtime dispatch tables and never spells a runtime name (ratchet-enforced: molecule-ai-workspace-runtime/tests/test_engine_no_runtime_dispatch_ratchet.py). Runtime keys are the underscore spelling (mcp_render.normalize_runtime): hyphenated `name` -> underscore key.
seam_ownership: Per ADR-004, each seam is owned by the template repo's adapter (the socket methods render/read/present/enumerate/materialize). Fields below name the ADAPTER method that owns the seam, not an engine symbol. `native_*` fields (path/format/identity-file) remain the descriptive contract each adapter's implementation must satisfy.

mcp.register_mcp_server_hook: adapter.register_mcp_server_hook (writes the native json mcpServers map)
adapter.register_mcp_server_hook (merges resolved platform env literals into spec.env, then writes the native config.toml mcp_servers table)
adapter.register_mcp_server_hook (writes the native config.yaml mcp_servers map, yaml.safe_dump sort_keys=False, additive/idempotent)
mcp.reader: adapter.enumerate_loaded_mcp_tools reads its own ~/.hermes/config.yaml mcp_servers (runtime#181 — the hermes adapter owns loaded-tools discovery, probing its native config directly)
mcp.enumerate_loaded_mcp_tools: adapter.enumerate_loaded_mcp_tools (reads own config.yaml mcp_servers, hands stdio specs to enumerate_from_specs_async)

persona.materializer: adapter.materialize_persona (writes ~/.hermes/SOUL.md — hermes-agent's Layer-1 Agent Identity — from config.system_prompt via persona_render.read_canonical_persona + write_persona)
persona.note: REQUIRED, not optional: the a2a-platform transport (MOLECULE_A2A_PLATFORM_ENABLED=true) forwards to hermes-agent WITHOUT config.system_prompt, so SOUL.md is the only channel that makes a concierge speak as the Org Concierge on that transport. Native identity convention is pinned against hermes-agent's documented prompt assembly (website/docs/developer-guide/prompt-assembly.md — Layer-1 = ~/.hermes/SOUL.md). Byte-identical to the persona the deleted engine helper wrote.

mcp.register_mcp_server_hook: adapter.register_mcp_server_hook (merges resolved platform env literals into spec.env; owns its native renderer directly so it works on runtime versions predating any engine openclaw renderer)
mcp.management_mcp_present: adapter.management_mcp_present (reads ~/.openclaw/openclaw.json mcp.servers directly, same runtime-version reason as the render override)

persona.materializer: adapter.materialize_persona (writes SOUL.md + clears the placeholder files, via persona_render.read_canonical_persona + write_persona)
